title: Review the software design to verify compliance with security requirements and risk information
reason: The design of the gate, the deploy and the site is checked against the security requirements and risks in their threat models, and a model turns suspect when its element changes. An automated review in the toolchain (PW.2.1's second option) runs in the security test: every threat model models an active element, covers the six STRIDE categories, and every mitigation resolves to an object or a file that exists. Partial: that review checks the models' structure and references, not whether their threats are complete; eight of the eleven components have no threat model, and the three models stay written until someone other than their author reviews them (no review step, D-055).
